name: terminal-normal
netlist:
simulator lang=spectre
global 0
ahdl_include "dut.va"
ahdl_include "support_cmp.va"
Vdd (vdd 0) vsource dc=1
Vref (vref 0) vsource dc=.5
Vin (vin 0) vsource type=pwl wave=[0 .42 10.4n 0.598 20.4n .42 30.4n 0.607 40.4n .41 44.4n .41]
Vbegin (begin_round 0) vsource type=pwl wave=[0 0 21.4n 0 21.42n 1 21.6n 1 21.62n 0 44.4n 0]
XC (vdd 0 vin vref cmp_out) support_hysteretic_comparator offset=0.013 vhys=0.064 td=180p tr=30p
XM (vin cmp_out begin_round up down width valid) hysteresis_meter
tran tran stop=44n maxstep=20p
save vin cmp_out begin_round up down width valid
